summary: Keep operational ticket intake and sync from blocking clean-primary execution

delivery.outcome: Provide a repository-bound operational intake store mode that persists tickets, allocator high-water state, and sync state outside tracked working-tree files while preserving project identity, GitHub bindings, CAS, deduplication, cross-worktree visibility, and rollback.
nonGoals: Never automatically reset, stash, delete, or commit unknown primary checkout changes.
Do not weaken Coding Agent or governance dirty-source admission checks.

architecture.decision: Resolve repository-bound operational store paths under the canonical Git common directory (or configured operationalStoreRoot) and seed/recover state non-destructively from any tracked .planfile directory while binding SyncState.store_identity to the canonical primary .planfile path.

components.name: Operational store routing and sync state binding

interfaceChanges: Store(directory, operational=...) plus Store.enable_operational_intake and Store.rollback_operational_intake
Operational store discovery helpers in planfile.project_paths
architecture.rollback: Revert the operational store routing helpers and Store/SyncState bindings via an independent publication PR, or call Store.rollback_operational_intake().

validation.evidence: Disposable tracked-Planfile fixture creates and syncs a ticket in operational mode while git status --porcelain stays empty.
Dirty tracked source file in the primary checkout still reports dirty working tree and fails clean-primary admission.
Interrupted migration recovery and rollback preserve ticket IDs, allocator highwater, store_identity, and GitHub sync mappings.
Round-trip across primary checkout, linked delivery worktree, and FastAPI app shares the same operational store and ticket state.
